bullets: Mask Values are ADDED to Masked (Scaled) Values
Addition of "0" does not change the original values, consequently no effect on Softmax output
Addition of "-inf" gets "Zero" output of Softmax, leaving zero attention scores for future Words.
equations: Mask matrix (rows = query words, columns = key words): SOS: [0, -∞, -∞, -∞, -∞]; Je: [0, 0, -∞, -∞, -∞]; me: [0, 0, 0, -∞, -∞]; sens: [0, 0, 0, 0, -∞]; malade: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

layout.arrangement: White slide with a thin red rectangular border frame inset from the gray video background. Two-line red/blue title top-center. Yellow circular slide-number badge top-right corner. Softmax label + boxed equation top-right below the badge. Full-width blue-bordered statement box near the bottom, followed by two lines of explanatory text below it. Thin black strip along the very bottom edge (video player chrome).
